ex.en: It is nearly eight.
ex.zh: 快八点了。

ex.en: A clinic that is nearly an hour away is too far for a child who cannot breathe well.
ex.zh: 将近一小时路程的诊所，对呼吸困难的孩子来说太远了。

tip: nearly 和 almost 常可互换；almost 更能修饰 no 和 never。

senses.en: a set of movements, or a social event

ex.en: They dance in the hall on Fridays.
ex.zh: 他们周五在大厅跳舞。

ex.en: A school dance can bring a class together if the cost does not keep some students out.
ex.zh: 如果费用不把一些学生挡在外面，学校舞会可以把一个班聚在一起。

tip: dance 也可作名词“舞蹈”。

ex.en: Blue is her favorite colour.
ex.zh: 蓝色是她最喜欢的颜色。

ex.en: A student's favorite reading place may be a shared table, not a quiet room of their own.
ex.zh: 学生最喜欢的阅读地点可能是一张共用的桌子，而不是自己的安静房间。

tip: favorite 是美式拼写；英式是 favourite。意思相同。

senses.en: further than, or outside the range of

ex.en: The village is beyond the hill.
ex.zh: 村子在山的那一边。

ex.en: The cost of dirty air goes beyond the hospital bill and into lost days at school.
ex.zh: 脏空气的代价超出医院账单，还包括在学校损失的天数。

tip: beyond 是介词，后接名词。

senses.en: a hot drink made from leaves

ex.en: The teachers drink tea in the office.
ex.zh: 老师们在办公室喝茶。

ex.en: Afternoon tea in some families is a meal, not only a cup.
ex.zh: 在有些家庭，下午茶是一餐，而不只是一杯饮料。

tip: tea 作物质名词不可数。a tea 可以指一杯茶。

senses.en: to become different, or to replace

ex.en: We changed the time of the meeting.
ex.zh: 我们改了开会时间。

ex.en: Cities that change bus routes without warning leave workers late and children waiting in the dark.
ex.zh: 不预先通知就更改公交线路的城市，会让工人迟到，让孩子在黑暗中等候。

tip: change 可作及物或不及物动词。

senses.en: to try to win against others
Take part in a sporting event or other contest.

ex.en: Many teams compete for the prize.
ex.zh: 许多队伍竞争这个奖项。

ex.en: Small businesses often struggle to compete with larger companies that can offer lower prices.
ex.zh: 小企业往往难以与能够提供更低价格的大公司竞争。

col: compete in a tournament｜参加锦标赛
tip: compete with/against对手；for奖项；in赛事。

ex.en: The price is reasonable.
ex.zh: 价格公道。

ex.en: A reasonable timetable leaves time to eat, not only time to score.
ex.zh: 合理的课表留出吃饭的时间，而不只是得分的时间。

tip: reasonable 来自 reason。It is reasonable to do。

senses.en: a period of one hundred years

ex.en: The bridge was built in the last century.
ex.zh: 这座桥建于上个世纪。

ex.en: A town that grew in one century can lose its river in a single decade of careless building.
ex.zh: 一个世纪里成长起来的城镇，可能在十年粗心的建设中失去它的河。

tip: in the twentieth century 表示在二十世纪。

ex.en: Are you ready for the listening test?
ex.zh: 听力测试你准备好了吗？

ex.en: A town is not ready for a flood if the only high road is already full of parked cars.
ex.zh: 如果唯一的高路已经停满车，一个城镇就还没有为洪水做好准备。

col: be ready to do｜准备好做
tip: be ready for 后接名词；be ready to do 后接动词。

senses.en: a complete change in government or in a way of doing something

ex.en: The chapter describes the revolution in simple words.
ex.zh: 这一章用简单的话描述那场革命。

ex.en: A revolution in bus routes still needs a map the next morning.
ex.zh: 公交线路的大变革，第二天早上仍然需要一张地图。

tip: revolution 可数。也可指旋转一周。

senses.en: the points in a game or test
to get a point or a mark

ex.en: The final score was two to one.
ex.zh: 最终比分是二比一。

ex.en: A low score on a listening test may show noise in the room, not only a weak ear.
ex.zh: 听力测验分数低，可能说明房间吵，而不只是耳朵不行。

tip: score 作动词是得分。比分的说法是 two to one。

senses.en: not controlled by another person, organisation, or country
not connected with or affected by something else

ex.en: She became more independent at college.
ex.zh: 她上大学后更独立了。

ex.en: Independent research can help governments assess whether new environmental policies are achieving their intended goals.
ex.zh: 独立研究可以帮助政府评估新的环境政策是否正在实现预期目标。

tip: 常搭配of：independent of意为不依赖或不受影响。

ex.en: The decision depends upon the bus timetable.
ex.zh: 这个决定取决于公交时刻表。

ex.en: Once upon a time is a story opening, but real towns still depend upon roads and water.
ex.zh: Once upon a time 是故事的开头，但真实的城镇仍然依靠道路和水。

tip: upon 比 on 更正式，意思常常相同。

senses.en: to stay, or to be left

ex.en: Please remain in your seats until the bell.
ex.zh: 铃响前请留在座位上。

ex.en: The questions that remain after a lesson are often the ones worth writing down.
ex.zh: 一节课结束后仍留下的问题，往往值得写下来。

col: it remains to be seen｜尚待分晓
tip: remain 是连系动词，后接形容词：remain calm。不能说 remain to do 表示“仍然要做”时要小心，剩下要做的常用 it remains to do。

ex.en: That is a good idea for the poster.
ex.zh: 对海报来说那是个好主意。

ex.en: An idea for a new park fails if nobody asks who will water the trees after the opening day.
ex.zh: 如果没人问开放日之后谁来给树浇水，建新公园的想法就会失败。

tip: idea 是可数名词：an idea。

senses.en: one side of a sheet in a book

ex.en: The answer is on page twelve.
ex.zh: 答案在第十二页。

ex.en: A torn page in a shared textbook matters when the school cannot buy a new copy.
ex.zh: 当学校买不起新书时，共用课本上撕掉的一页就很要紧。

tip: page 前用 on：on page 5。

senses.en: to make a picture, or to pull

ex.en: Draw the map before you write the paragraph.
ex.zh: 写段落之前先把地图画出来。

ex.en: Cities draw young workers when housing and night buses exist, not only when the posters are bright.
ex.zh: 当住房和夜班公交都存在时，城市才会吸引年轻工人，而不只是海报鲜亮的时候。

tip: draw 的过去式是 drew，过去分词是 drawn。draw 也可表示吸引。

senses.en: to do something, or to perform

ex.en: We must act before the river rises again.
ex.zh: 我们必须在河水再次上涨前行动。

ex.en: Schools that act on student suggestions show that those suggestions were not only a form to fill.
ex.zh: 根据学生建议采取行动的学校，表明那些建议不只是一张要填的表。

tip: act 强调行动；action 是名词。

senses.en: one of the four parts of the year, or a sports period

ex.en: Autumn is my favourite season.
ex.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。

ex.en: A long dry season can empty village wells before the next rain arrives.
ex.zh: 漫长的旱季会在下一场雨到来前抽干村里的水井。

tip: 季节前常用 in：in summer。

ex.en: Please sit down and open your books.
ex.zh: 请坐下，把书打开。

ex.en: When a factory closes down, the town has to find new work for the people who stayed.
ex.zh: 当一家工厂倒闭时，城镇必须为留下来的人找到新的工作。

tip: down 可作副词或介词：walk down the street。

senses.en: to give an answer without being sure

ex.en: Can you guess the last word?
ex.zh: 你能猜出最后一个词吗？

ex.en: Planners should not guess where floods reach when residents can show them the marks on the wall.
ex.zh: 当居民能指出墙上的水痕时，规划者不该猜测洪水淹到哪里。

tip: guess 后可直接接从句。

senses.en: to speak to a god, or to hope strongly

ex.en: Some students pray before the meal.
ex.zh: 有些学生饭前祈祷。

ex.en: A school can leave time to pray without making it a rule for everyone.
ex.zh: 学校可以留出祈祷的时间，而不把它变成每个人的规定。

tip: 名词 prayer 是本批的另一词。本条不是劝人信教。

senses.en: a plant smaller than a tree

ex.en: The bush by the gate needs cutting.
ex.zh: 门口的灌木该修剪了。

ex.en: A bush that hides the crossing sign is not decoration; move it.
ex.zh: 挡住路口标志的灌木不是装饰，把它移开。

tip: bush 可数。the bush 在有的国家指荒野。

ex.en: The sudden rain closed the match.
ex.zh: 突然的雨让比赛停了。

ex.en: A sudden change in the bus time should be written the same hour.
ex.zh: 公交时间的突然改变，应当在同一小时写出来。

tip: suddenly 是副词。

senses.en: a piece of equipment that does work

ex.en: This machine copies the notice for every class.
ex.zh: 这台机器给每个班复印通知。

ex.en: A washing machine saves time, but a school still has to teach students how to share one.
ex.zh: 洗衣机能省时间，但学校仍要教学生如何共用一台。

tip: machine 是可数名词。统称机器设备常用 machinery，不可数。

senses.en: having the power or skill to do something

ex.en: She is able to explain the diagram clearly.
ex.zh: 她能把这张图讲清楚。

ex.en: Students are more able to concentrate when the classroom is quiet and the air is fresh.
ex.zh: 当教室安静、空气新鲜时，学生更能集中注意力。

tip: can 多指一般能力；be able to 可用于各种时态，并强调做成。

ex.en: Keep the same format for every notice.
ex.zh: 每则通知用同一格式。

ex.en: A clear format names the time before the welcome.
ex.zh: 清楚的格式先写时间，再写欢迎。

tip: format 作动词是编排，计算机里也可指格式化。本条不写破坏数据的操作。

senses.en: the main subject receiving attention or effort
image sharpness, or the point where light rays meet

ex.en: Keep your focus on the task.
ex.zh: 把注意力集中在任务上。

ex.en: Governments should focus on affordable public transport to reduce congestion and improve access to employment.
ex.zh: 政府应重点发展价格合理的公共交通，以缓解拥堵并改善就业机会的可达性。

tip: focus on后接名词或动名词；不要说focus in。

ex.en: The red bag on the chair is mine.
ex.zh: 椅子上的红包是我的。

ex.en: Red warnings on a river app help only if people who live nearby can actually receive them.
ex.zh: 河流应用上的红色警报只有在附近居民真能收到时才有用。

tip: red 也可作名词表示红色。

ex.en: She said bye at the gate.
ex.zh: 她在门口说了再见。

ex.en: A bye on the phone is not a record of the bus time.
ex.zh: 电话里一声再见不是公交时间的记录。

tip: bye 是 goodbye 的口语。

senses.en: the main meal of the day

ex.en: Dinner is at six in our hall.
ex.zh: 我们食堂六点开晚饭。

ex.en: A free dinner at school can matter more than a speech about healthy food.
ex.zh: 学校的一顿免费晚餐，可能比一场关于健康饮食的演讲更重要。

tip: dinner 在不同地方可以指午餐或晚餐，都是一天的正餐。

ex.en: The arrival of the bus was late.
ex.zh: 公交到达晚了。

ex.en: The arrival time should be on the same sheet as the return time.
ex.zh: 到达时间应当和返回时间写在同一张纸上。

tip: 动词 arrive 是本批的另一词。arrival 通常不可数，一次到达可以说 an arrival。

ex.en: The lab has one PC for two students.
ex.zh: 实验室里两名学生共用一台个人电脑。

ex.en: A PC at home does not replace a quiet place to read.
ex.zh: 家里的个人电脑代替不了一个安静的阅读角落。

col: a school PC｜学校的个人电脑
tip: PC 与 p.c. 是同一个缩写，本库只保留 PC。personal computer 已在本库。

senses.en: to carry something towards the speaker

ex.en: Please bring your student card tomorrow.
ex.zh: 请明天带学生证。

ex.en: New jobs bring people to a town only if there is also a place for them to live.
ex.zh: 只有同时有地方住，新工作才会把人带到一个城镇。

tip: bring 是带来（朝说话人）；take 是带走。过去式是 brought。

ex.en: The library has various maps of the town.
ex.zh: 图书馆有各种各样的城镇地图。

ex.en: Various reasons, from rent to bus times, push young workers out of a small town.
ex.zh: 从房租到公交时间，各种各样的原因把年轻工人推出小镇。

tip: various 后接复数名词。

ex.en: The reason for the delay was the rain.
ex.zh: 延误的原因是下雨。

ex.en: The reason a street floods is often an old drain, not only a heavy cloud.
ex.zh: 街道积水的原因常常是旧排水管，而不只是厚云。

tip: the reason 后用 why 或 that，不要再用 because 重复原因。

ex.en: The bag is leather.
ex.zh: 这个包是皮的。

ex.en: Leather shoes still need a dry place after the rain.
ex.zh: 皮鞋在雨后仍然需要一个干的地方。

tip: leather 作材料通常不可数。

ex.en: Asia appears on the first map in the book.
ex.zh: 亚洲出现在书里的第一张地图上。

ex.en: A chapter about Asia should not treat the whole continent as one climate.
ex.zh: 写亚洲的一章不应当把整块大陆当成同一种气候。

tip: Asia 要大写。形容词 Asian 已在本库。

ex.en: What colour is the new notice?
ex.zh: 新通知是什么颜色？

ex.en: The colour of flood water does not tell you whether it is safe.
ex.zh: 洪水的颜色并不能告诉你它是否安全。

tip: colour 是英式，color 是美式，已在本库。两条都保留，因为考纲里都有，搜索只匹配词头。

ex.en: She has brown eyes.
ex.zh: 她有棕色的眼睛。

ex.en: Too little light in a classroom tires the eye before the lesson is over.
ex.zh: 教室光线太暗，课还没结束眼睛就累了。

tip: eye 的复数是 eyes。

ex.en: frequent rain delayed the flight.
ex.zh: 频繁的降雨延误了航班。

ex.en: Frequent changes in education policy can make it difficult for teachers to plan effective lessons.
ex.zh: 教育政策频繁变化，可能使教师难以规划有效的课堂教学。

tip: 形容词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: the time from noon until evening

ex.en: The match is on Friday afternoon.
ex.zh: 比赛在周五下午。

ex.en: A hot afternoon in a room with shut windows is a health problem, not a character test.
ex.zh: 窗户关着的炎热下午是健康问题，不是对性格的考验。

tip: 泛指下午用 in the afternoon。具体某一天用 on Friday afternoon。

senses.en: a shirt with short sleeves and no collar

ex.en: He wore a clean T-shirt to the photo.
ex.zh: 他穿着干净的 T 恤去拍照。

ex.en: A T-shirt rule that costs too much keeps some students out of the team photo.
ex.zh: 花费过高的 T 恤规定，会让一些学生进不了集体照。

col: a cotton T-shirt｜棉 T 恤
tip: T-shirt 也可写成 tee shirt。shirt 是本批的另一词，通常有领。

ex.en: Math is the first lesson on Monday.
ex.zh: 周一第一节是数学。

ex.en: A math problem about the bus is more useful than a number with no story.
ex.zh: 一道关于公交的数学题，比一个没有情境的数字更有用。

tip: math 是美式简称。英式常用 maths。本库用考纲里的 math。学科前通常不加 the，但可以说 the math lesson。

senses.en: a large vehicle for carrying goods

ex.en: The truck blocked the school gate.
ex.zh: 卡车堵住了校门。

ex.en: A truck route that avoids the gate is safer than a sign that says slow.
ex.zh: 避开校门的卡车路线，比一块写着慢行的牌子更安全。

tip: truck 是美式。英式常用 lorry。

ex.en: A recent photo shows the new bridge.
ex.zh: 一张近照展示了新桥。

ex.en: Recent floods should change where the town allows new houses, not only this year's repairs.
ex.zh: 最近的洪水应该改变城镇允许建新房的位置，而不只是今年的修补。

tip: recent 是形容词；recently 是副词。

ex.en: Please write your name at the end of the page.
ex.zh: 请把名字写在页尾。

ex.en: The end of a holiday is a good time to ask which local shops actually benefited from the visitors.
ex.zh: 假期结束时，适合问问哪些本地店铺真正从游客那里获益。

tip: in the end 表示最终；at the end of 后面要接具体的时间或事物。

senses.en: a contract that pays if something bad happens

ex.en: Health insurance helped the family pay the bill.
ex.zh: 健康保险帮助这个家庭付了账单。

ex.en: Insurance does not replace a clinic that is close enough to reach at night.
ex.zh: 保险替代不了一家夜里能够到达的诊所。

tip: insurance 通常不可数。

ex.en: The topic is sensitive, so the names stay off the board.
ex.zh: 这个话题很敏感，所以名字不写在板上。

ex.en: A sensitive teacher notices who has no coat before the speech about weather.
ex.zh: 体贴的老师在关于天气的讲话之前，就会注意到谁没有外套。

tip: sensitive 可指容易受影响，也可指善解人意。不要和 sensible（明智的）混淆。

ex.en: The soup was delicious.
ex.zh: 这汤很好喝。

ex.en: Delicious food that hides nuts should say so on the label.
ex.zh: 藏着坚果的美食应当在标签上写明。

tip: delicious 形容食物。

senses.en: to make something full, or to write information

ex.en: Fill the form before you leave.
ex.zh: 离开前把表填好。

ex.en: Bottles that fill the recycling bin by noon show the canteen what it sells.
ex.zh: 中午就把回收桶装满的瓶子，告诉食堂它在卖什么。

tip: 填表英式常用 fill in，美式常用 fill out。

senses.en: unable to see, or not based on reason

ex.en: The sign is in large print for students who are not fully blind but cannot read small type.
ex.zh: 牌子用大字，给那些并非全盲但看不清小字的学生。

ex.en: A blind rule that ignores the last bus will fail the students who need it.
ex.zh: 无视末班车的盲目规定，会让需要它的学生吃亏。

col: turn a blind eye｜视而不见
tip: 说视力时要尊重对方。blind 也可比喻盲目。用 the blind 指一类人时要谨慎。

senses.en: a building where goods are made

ex.en: The factory is outside the town.
ex.zh: 工厂在镇外。

ex.en: A factory near a school should publish what it releases into the air.
ex.zh: 学校附近的工厂应当公布它排到空气里的东西。

tip: factory 可数。表里没有这一条，本库用 espeak-ng。

senses.en: to want something that may not be real

ex.en: I wish you a good journey.
ex.zh: 祝你旅途愉快。

ex.en: Residents wish the clinic were closer, but wishes do not move a building.
ex.zh: 居民希望诊所更近，但愿望搬不走一座楼。

tip: wish 后接虚拟语气，表示与事实相反；hope 后接真实的希望。

senses.en: a flower with a sweet smell and thorns

ex.en: She put a rose on the teacher's desk.
ex.zh: 她在老师桌上放了一朵玫瑰。

ex.en: A rose in the school garden needs water in August, when most students are away.
ex.zh: 学校花园里的玫瑰在八月需要浇水，而那时大多数学生不在。

tip: rose 也是 rise（上升）的过去式。作花名时是名词。

senses.en: a small disc on clothes, or a control you press

ex.en: The button on the coat is loose.
ex.zh: 外套上的扣子松了。

ex.en: A button that calls the office should be where a student can reach it.
ex.zh: 呼叫办公室的按钮应当装在学生够得着的地方。

tip: button 作动词是扣上。

ex.en: The room will become quiet when the talk starts.
ex.zh: 讲座开始时房间会安静下来。

ex.en: A neighbourhood can become unsafe for walking if shops close and the street lights fail.
ex.zh: 如果商店关门、路灯不亮，一个社区会变得不适合步行。

tip: become 后接形容词或名词，不加 to be。过去分词仍是 become。

senses.en: land with water all around it

ex.en: We read a story about a small island.
ex.zh: 我们读了一个关于小岛的故事。

ex.en: An island school depends on the boat timetable as much as on its teachers.
ex.zh: 岛上的学校对船的时刻表的依赖，不亚于对老师的依赖。

tip: island 前的元音用 an：an island。

ex.en: The cake has too much cream.
ex.zh: 这蛋糕奶油太多。

ex.en: Cream left in the sun is not a treat; it is a risk.
ex.zh: 放在太阳下的奶油不是款待，是风险。

tip: cream 通常不可数。ice cream 是冰淇淋。

ex.en: Good luck on the oral test tomorrow.
ex.zh: 祝你明天口语考试好运。

ex.en: Luck may open a door, but a student still has to walk through it with preparation.
ex.zh: 运气也许能打开一扇门，但学生仍要靠准备自己走进去。

col: a stroke of luck｜一次走运
tip: luck 不可数。祝愿用 Good luck，不要说 a good luck。

senses.en: the earth, or a particular area of activity

ex.en: Students from three countries joined the world map project.
ex.zh: 来自三个国家的学生参加了世界地图项目。

ex.en: The online world gives teenagers a voice, but it also spreads rumours faster than a classroom can correct them.
ex.zh: 网络世界给了青少年发言的机会，但谣言传播的速度也快过课堂能够纠正的速度。

tip: in the world 常与最高级连用，加强语气。

ex.en: Parents were worried about the late bus.
ex.zh: 家长担心晚到的公交。

ex.en: A worried note from a student is information, not a nuisance.
ex.zh: 学生写来的担心是信息，不是麻烦。

tip: worried 形容人。worry 已在本库。worrying 形容令人担心的事物。

senses.en: the legal end of a marriage

ex.en: The form does not ask about divorce in public.
ex.zh: 表格不在公开场合询问离婚。

ex.en: A school should not shame a student because of a divorce at home.
ex.zh: 学校不应当因为家里的离婚而让学生感到羞耻。

tip: divorce 作动词是离婚。说话时要尊重家庭。

senses.en: a senior priest in some Christian churches

ex.en: The history text mentions a bishop, not a rule for today.
ex.zh: 历史课文提到一位主教，不是今天的规定。

ex.en: A visit to a church can name the bishop and still not tell students what to believe.
ex.zh: 参观教堂可以提到主教，同时仍然不告诉学生该信什么。

tip: bishop 是称谓。本条是词汇，不是劝人信教。

senses.en: to take liquid into the mouth

ex.en: Drink some water before the run.
ex.zh: 跑步前喝点水。

ex.en: Towns that drink from the same river have to agree on what factories may pour into it.
ex.zh: 共用一条河取水的城镇，必须约定工厂可以向河里排什么。

tip: drink 的过去式是 drank，过去分词是 drunk。

senses.en: a group with a purpose, or the act of arranging

ex.en: The organization collected books for the village school.
ex.zh: 这个组织为乡村学校收集了书。

ex.en: Good organization of a fire drill matters more than a long speech about safety.
ex.zh: 消防演习的良好组织，比关于安全的长篇讲话更重要。

tip: organization 是美式拼写；英式常用 organisation。

ex.en: The rumour was false.
ex.zh: 那则谣言是假的。

ex.en: A false alarm still needs a check, or the next real one will be ignored.
ex.zh: 假警报仍然需要核查，否则下一次真的会被忽视。

tip: false 是形容词。名词错误用 mistake 或 error。

ex.en: An empty bus at four is unusual.
ex.zh: 四点的空公交不寻常。

ex.en: An unusual result in the lab is a reason to measure again.
ex.zh: 实验室里不寻常的结果，是再测一次的理由。

tip: usual 已在本库。unusual 是反义。

senses.en: of the colour between black and white; British spelling

ex.en: The sky is grey this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上天空是灰色的。

ex.en: A grey area in the rule should be written in one sentence.
ex.zh: 规定里的灰色地带应当用一句话写清。

tip: grey 是英式，gray 是美式。考纲里两种都有，本库两条都保留，搜索只匹配词头。

ex.en: Dust covered the map.
ex.zh: 地图上满是灰尘。

ex.en: Dust in the lab is a reason to cover the bottles.
ex.zh: 实验室里的灰尘是把瓶子盖上的理由。

col: a cloud of dust｜一片尘土
tip: dust 通常不可数。作动词是掸灰。

senses.en: an act of travelling from one place to another

ex.en: The journey takes two hours by bus.
ex.zh: 这段路程乘公交要两小时。

ex.en: A journey to a museum teaches more when the return time is written on the same sheet.
ex.zh: 如果回程时间写在同一张纸上，去博物馆的旅程会更有收获。

tip: journey 常比 trip 更长或更正式。动词旅行用 travel。

ex.en: The rumour is ridiculous.
ex.zh: 这则谣言很荒谬。

ex.en: It is ridiculous to blame a student for a bus the town cancelled.
ex.zh: 因为城镇取消的公交去责备学生，是荒谬的。

tip: ridiculous 程度很强。不要用来嘲笑同学的外表。

ex.en: We learn new words by using them.
ex.zh: 我们通过使用来学会生词。

ex.en: Children learn road safety by walking with an adult, not only by reading a poster.
ex.zh: 孩子通过和成年人一起走路来学习交通安全，而不只是读海报。

tip: learn 强调学会；study 强调学习的过程。

senses.en: protection, or the argument for someone

ex.en: The town's defense against floods is still a low wall.
ex.zh: 城镇的防洪仍然只是一堵矮墙。

ex.en: A strong defense of a plan should include the people who disagree with it.
ex.zh: 对一个计划的有力辩护，应该包括不同意它的人。

tip: defense 是美式拼写；英式是 defence。

ex.en: The path is broad enough for two people.
ex.zh: 这条路宽得能过两个人。

ex.en: A broad rule that says nothing clear is harder to follow than a short one.
ex.zh: 一条宽泛却什么也没说清的规定，比一条短的更难遵守。

tip: broad 与 wide 相近。broad 更常用于比喻：a broad range。

senses.en: to take something from a person or place by force

ex.en: The novel says the shop was robbed, and then it stops.
ex.zh: 小说写商店被抢，然后就停住了。

ex.en: News of a robbery should give the place and the date, not a method.
ex.zh: 抢劫新闻应当给出地点和日期，而不是方法。

tip: rob 的宾语是人或地方，不是被抢走的东西。steal 的宾语才是东西。本条不写作案方法。

ex.en: The library is to the south of the stadium.
ex.zh: 图书馆在体育馆南边。

ex.en: Towns in the south may face longer summers, which changes when schools can hold sports outdoors.
ex.zh: 南方的城镇可能面临更长的夏天，这会改变学校何时能在户外运动。

tip: in the south of 表示在某范围的南部；to the south of 表示在某地以南。

senses.en: to speak or act for someone, or to be a sign of something

ex.en: She will represent the class at the meeting.
ex.zh: 她将在会上代表班级。

ex.en: One photo does not represent every family that uses the school.
ex.zh: 一张照片代表不了使用这所学校的每一个家庭。

tip: 名词 representative 是本批的另一词，指代表或典型的。

ex.en: The box is too heavy for one person.
ex.zh: 这个箱子一个人搬太重。

ex.en: Heavy rain on a street with small drains becomes a flood within an hour.
ex.zh: 排水管很小的街道上的大雨，会在一小时内变成洪水。

tip: heavy 的比较级是 heavier。

ex.en: The problem still exists after the meeting.
ex.zh: 会后问题仍然存在。

ex.en: A rule that exists only on paper does not protect the student who needs it.
ex.zh: 只存在于纸上的规定，保护不了需要它的学生。

tip: exist 是不及物动词，没有被动式。there exist 是较正式的 there be。

ex.en: The question is rather difficult.
ex.zh: 这道题相当难。

ex.en: Many students would rather walk than take a bus that arrives after the gate has closed.
ex.zh: 许多学生宁愿走路，也不愿坐一辆校门关上后才到的公交。

tip: would rather do than do 表示宁愿……而不愿。rather than 后常接不带 to 的动词。

senses.en: to talk in a friendly way

ex.en: We had a chat after class.
ex.zh: 课后我们聊了聊。

ex.en: A chat in the hallway is not a record; write the decision down.
ex.zh: 走廊里的聊天不是记录，把决定写下来。

tip: chat 作动词同义。比 discussion 随意。

senses.en: to speak or write about something briefly

ex.en: She did not mention the test date.
ex.zh: 她没有提到考试日期。

ex.en: Reports that mention a river but not the villages along it miss half the story.
ex.zh: 只提到河、不提沿岸村子的报道，漏掉了一半内容。

col: mention sth to sb｜向某人提到
tip: mention 后直接接内容，不说 mention about。

senses.en: to cause pain, or to feel pain

ex.en: My knee hurts after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛后我的膝盖疼。

ex.en: Words can hurt, and a false story about a classmate can last longer than the speaker expects.
ex.zh: 话能伤人，关于同学的假故事可能比说话的人预计的更长久。

tip: hurt 的过去式和过去分词仍是 hurt。

ex.en: A ray of sun reached the back row.
ex.zh: 一束阳光照到了后排。

ex.en: One ray of light in a stairwell can stop a fall that a speech about safety will not.
ex.zh: 楼梯间的一束光能防止摔倒，而一篇关于安全的讲话做不到。

tip: a ray of hope 表示一线希望。

senses.en: concerned with real use, not only ideas

ex.en: The plan is practical: it names the bus.
ex.zh: 这个计划是实际的：它写了公交。

ex.en: Practical help is a seat and a time, not only a kind sentence.
ex.zh: 实际的帮助是一个座位和一个时间，而不只是一句善意的话。

tip: practice 已在本库。practical 是形容词。

senses.en: to move by turning over and over
something rolled, a small loaf, or a list

ex.en: The ball rolled under the desk.
ex.zh: 球滚到了桌子底下。

ex.en: Teachers roll a new plan out slowly when the old timetable still has to finish the term.
ex.zh: 旧课表还要撑完这个学期时，老师会慢慢推出新方案。

tip: roll 作名词可以是小圆面包、名册或卷。

senses.en: one of four equal parts, or fifteen minutes

ex.en: It is a quarter past eight.
ex.zh: 现在是八点一刻。

ex.en: A quarter of the class walking is still a crowd if the pavement is one person wide.
ex.zh: 如果人行道只有一个人宽，即使只有四分之一的班级步行，也仍是拥挤。

tip: 一刻钟是 fifteen minutes，口语常用 a quarter。美式 quarter 也可指 25 美分。

senses.en: a piece of work to be done

ex.en: The first task is to count the chairs.
ex.zh: 第一项任务是数椅子。

ex.en: A task without a name on it becomes everybody's job and nobody's job.
ex.zh: 没有写上名字的任务，会变成每个人的事，也变成没有人的事。

tip: task 可数。比 work 更具体。

senses.en: a wash under falling water, or a short fall of rain

ex.en: There is a shower on the second floor.
ex.zh: 二楼有淋浴。

ex.en: A shower of rain at the gate is a reason to open the hall, not to cancel the bus.
ex.zh: 门口的一阵雨是开放礼堂的理由，不是取消公交。

tip: 淋浴和阵雨是同一个词。

senses.en: a place where minerals are dug

ex.en: This bag is mine.
ex.zh: 这个包是我的。

ex.en: A river is not mine or yours alone; the town downstream drinks from it too.
ex.zh: 一条河不是我的或你一个人的；下游的城镇也从中取水。

col: a friend of mine｜我的一个朋友
tip: 名词性物主代词 mine 后面不再加名词。mine 作名词是“矿”。

senses.en: if not, or in a different way

ex.en: Hurry up; otherwise we will miss the bus.
ex.zh: 快点，否则我们会错过公交。

ex.en: Write the source down; otherwise a later reader cannot tell a fact from a guess.
ex.zh: 把来源写下来，否则后来的读者分不清事实和猜测。

tip: otherwise 可单独作“否则”。和 or 连用时不要再堆一个 else。

senses.en: a tall plant with a trunk and branches

ex.en: The old tree by the gate gives shade.
ex.zh: 门口的老树提供树荫。

ex.en: One tree in a schoolyard does not cool a city, but a row of them can change a street.
ex.zh: 校园里的一棵树凉不了一座城，但一排树可以改变一条街。

tip: tree 可数。木头作为材料用 wood，不是 tree。

senses.en: to make something by putting parts together

ex.en: They plan to build a bridge over the river.
ex.zh: 他们计划在河上建一座桥。

ex.en: Towns that build only roads forget that children also need a pavement.
ex.zh: 只修路的城镇忘了孩子也需要人行道。

tip: build 的过去式和过去分词是 built。

ex.en: The premier visited the new library.
ex.zh: 总理参观了新图书馆。

ex.en: A speech by the premier does not replace the bus the town was promised.
ex.zh: 总理的讲话代替不了城镇被承诺的那路公交。

tip: premier 与 prime minister 相近。作形容词是首要的，较少用。

senses.en: to give someone confidence or hope

ex.en: Teachers encourage students to ask.
ex.zh: 老师鼓励学生提问。

ex.en: Cities encourage walking when the path is lit, not only when the poster says so.
ex.zh: 当小路有灯而不只是海报这么说时，城市才是在鼓励步行。

col: encourage sb to do｜鼓励某人做
tip: encourage somebody to do。

ex.en: Be aware of the risks.
ex.zh: 要意识到风险。

ex.en: The annual sports meet is in May.
ex.zh: 一年一度的运动会在五月。

ex.en: An annual check of the school roof costs less than the damage after one storm.
ex.zh: 每年检查一次校舍屋顶，比一场暴风雨之后的损坏更省。

tip: annual 是形容词；annually 是副词。

ex.en: Select one route before you print the notice.
ex.zh: 打印通知前先选定一条路线。

ex.en: A school should not select only the already confident students for the lab.
ex.zh: 学校不应当只挑选已经自信的学生进实验室。

col: select sb to do｜挑选某人做
tip: select 比 choose 更正式。也可作形容词“精选的”。
